name: The Number 30
overview: The number 30 appears in Scripture within contexts of divine instruction and covenant responsibility, as seen in Moses' communication of God's commands to Israel (Numbers 30:1) and the Lord's direct speech to Moses (Numbers 31:1). It is connected to solemn occasions and commitments, such as the holy convocation on the first day of the seventh month marked by trumpet blowing (Numbers 29:1), and the serious nature of oaths and accountability before God (Leviticus 5:4). Ultimately, the number 30 points us to the authority of God's word and the necessity of obedience, culminating in the truth of Christ as the only way to the Father (John 14:6).
